description: Generate a Mermaid flowchart from a list of steps. Steps are linked in order; a decision (diamond) gets a 'Yes' edge to the next step, or to 'yes' if set, and a 'No' edge to 'no' if set. With projectId, saves the diagram to the project.

projectId.description: Id of the project to link this item to

decision.description: true if this is a decision point (diamond)

ends.description: true if this step is a final step with no outgoing arrow

next.description: Index of the step reached after this one (non-decisions). Defaults to the next step

no.description: Index of the step reached on No. Only for decisions; omit for no No branch

yes.description: Index of the step reached on Yes. Defaults to the next step

name: map_user_flow
